'''Zoochberry topping''' was a dessert topping made from [[Zoochberry/Legends|zoochberries]].<ref name="Dex" /> At some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] offered a choice of zoochberry topping or [[Trammistan chocolate]] on a [[Neuvian sundae]], which was sold for 2.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Dex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zoochberry topping was mentioned in [[Dining at Dex's]], a [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article written by [[Gregory Walker]].<ref name="Dex" />
